name: spellkave_explain
label: Spellkave Explain
description: Read authored role, binding, capability or extent-kind vocabulary. Files include the workspace closure and kernel bootstrap; live reads the connected world. Role answers include merged capabilities, contributing bundles and bound-to rows. Binding answers inspect the exact binding ID, its state, scope and derived elevation; identity details are self-only unless the publisher reads them. This grants no authority.
